# The Pitt: All spawn locations for the Fanatic Skeptic in mission 2, From Ashes to Fire.

With credit to Vicyorus.

Ava Rose will ask you to Persuade the Fanatic Skeptic, as one of the additional objectives for mission 2, From Ashes to Fire.

There are 5 different locations that this objective can spawn in. 3 in the Sanctum/Cathedral and 2 in the Trench.

Look for the Fanatic that is wearing a white bandana/cloth head piece.

Note, only the team leader can interact with the Fanatic Skeptic.

This additional objective requires a SPECIALS check to complete. You will need either 8+ Strength, 8+ Endurance, 8+ Intelligence or 8+ Perception to complete it successfully.

If you fail the SPECIAL check then the Skeptic will turn hostile and you will need to kill them, which means you have failed an objective and can potentially only reach tier 2 rewards.

The Fanatic Skeptic will show as a yellow dot on your HUD.

Once you are within 10 feet of the prisoner, a direct map marker will pop up.

## **__The Trenches__**

__The Trenches__

**First possible spawn location**

From the vertibird pad, head towards the tunnel as marked in the photo.

Go through the tunnel and turn left. Follow it to the end.

The Fanatic Skeptic can be found walking around at the end of the tunnel.

**Second possible spawn location**

From the Fanatic Labour Yard, enter the doorway that is between the yellow metal support arms that are holding the building up.

Once inside the ruined building, turn left and walk forward until you hit the brick wall and red metal double door.

The Fanatic Skeptic can be found down that allyway, digging through the trash.

## **__Sanctum__**

__Sanctum__

**First possible spawn location**

Upstairs in the room with the tinkers bench. Inside the Cathedral, in the same room that the Fanatic Foreman spawns.

**Second possible spawn location**

Upstairs, behind a closed gate, in the room with the bodies under the sheets. Inside the Cathedral, in the same room that the Fanatic Foreman spawns.

**Third possible spawn location**

Upstairs in the kitchen. Inside the Cathedral, in the same room that the Fanatic Foreman spawns.
